metadata.name: frankx.ai Starter Kit — founder-zero case
metadata.thesis: Solo AI builders who are overwhelmed by tool sprawl will buy a frankx.ai Starter Kit that packages inspectable architecture primitives into a first paid door, before any retainer.

nodes.label: Solo builders juggle too many AI tools without a coherent first paid door

provenance.method: founder interview / shared memory (solo developer overwhelmed by Codex, Claude Code, Antigravity, Grok Build, GitHub, local CLI, cloud agents)

nodes.evaluation: Five discovery calls. If fewer than three name tool sprawl or missing first offer as the blocker in their own words, retire this problem.

data.demandClaim: Operators will pay for a bounded starter kit rather than assemble the stack alone.

nodes.notes: demandClaim unsupported by paid Evidence as of 2026-11-07; see evidence-gap-no-paid-starter.

nodes.label: Solo AI architect / founder shipping with agents

provenance.method: founder self-segment for founder-zero case

nodes.evaluation: Ten conversations. If the buyer cannot name a next irreversible step the kit should unblock, the segment is wrong.

data.demandClaim: This buyer will purchase a low-ticket kit before a retainer.

nodes.notes: No paid customers recorded in this graph. Demand is founder-stated.

nodes.label: Founder-stated Starter Kit / Pack pricing intention (not a payment)

provenance.method: shared memory / Queen relay of Frank decisions on frankx Whop store and kit pricing

nodes.evaluation: Replace with a payment Evidence node the moment a real Whop/checkout invoice exists. Stated price is not paid price.

data.finding: On 2026-10-27 Frank's operating memory records intent for a frankx.ai €7 Six Primitives Pack and a €97 Starter Kit (Whop store direction). This is interview/memory provenance only. Live https://www.frankx.ai/templates (fetched 2026-11-07) lists Starter Kits / launch-list language and other USD product prices; it does not, by itself, prove €7/€97 checkout is live.

nodes.label: Evidence gap: zero attested paid Starter Kit customers

provenance.method: founder-zero honesty pass — no payment artifact in scope

nodes.evaluation: Invalidated when a payment Evidence node with kind=payment and a verifiable invoice/ref is added and attested.

data.finding: No revenue, no paid customer count, and no checkout transaction is claimed in this founder-zero graph.

nodes.label: Live frankx.ai templates surface mentions Starter Kits

provenance.method: HTTP fetch of live page (measured 200)

nodes.evaluation: Re-fetch quarterly. If Starter Kits copy disappears or contradicts the offer, drop or rewrite the Offer node.

data.finding: Page title/hero copy includes 'Starter Kits & Blueprints' / 'Sovereign Business Starter Kits & Templates' and lists items such as 'Agentic Micro-SaaS Starter Kit' with launch-list framing. This evidences a public starter-kit surface, not paid conversion.

nodes.label: frankx.ai Starter Kit (founder-zero lead offer)

provenance.method: founder pricing intention — not a live checkout edit

nodes.evaluation: A buyer completes checkout and opens the kit without a custom fulfillment thread. Until then, treat price as intention only.

data.demandClaim: €97 is approvable as a first paid door before any retainer.

nodes.notes: Price provenance = interview/memory 2026-10-27. Related €7 Six Primitives Pack is adjacent, not this Offer. No checkout/price page was edited in this stream.

nodes.label: Six Primitives Pack (adjacent low ticket — not lead)

provenance.method: founder pricing intention

nodes.evaluation: Exists as a separate SKU with its own fulfillment checklist; do not count Pack buyers as Starter Kit proof.

data.demandClaim: A €7 pack can capture browsers who will not yet buy the Starter Kit.

nodes.notes: Included for honesty about the 2026-10-27 kit ladder. Lead offer for this founder-zero case remains the Starter Kit.

nodes.label: frankx.ai site + Whop store direction

provenance.method: live site fetch + 2026-10-27 Whop-store memory

nodes.evaluation: Channel works when a stranger can reach a purchasable Starter Kit without a private DM. Today: surface exists; paid door not attested.

nodes.label: Circle community hub (launch)

provenance.method: founder decision: Circle is central community hub for the launch

nodes.evaluation: Members can find the Starter Kit offer from Circle without a founder DM.

nodes.label: Starter Kit assemble → review → publish → fulfill

provenance.method: founder-zero operating draft for platform coordination

nodes.evaluation: One dry-run fulfillment with a HumanGate release recorded before any customer delivery.

steps.action: Assemble kit contents from existing frankx primitives (no new price/checkout edits)
Strip unsourced claims; mark provenance on every priced statement
Frank reviews kit payload and sales copy
Publish or update the purchasable offer (Whop/checkout)
Deliver kit assets to a paying customer

nodes.label: Six Primitives Pack assemble → gate → deliver

provenance.method: adjacent SKU fulfillment stub for honesty of the kit ladder

nodes.evaluation: One dry-run delivery with HumanGate before any customer send.

steps.action: Assemble Six Primitives Pack files from existing primitives
Publish or update the purchasable pack offer
Deliver pack assets to a paying customer

nodes.label: Kit assembler / honesty editor

provenance.method: authority policy for founder-zero automation

nodes.evaluation: Weekly log: no price, checkout, DNS, secret, or delete actions by this role.

nodes.label: Frank Riemer

provenance.method: named principal

nodes.evaluation: Reachable within a working day; release log shows Frank, not an agent, clearing HumanGates.

nodes.label: Frank release before Starter Kit publish-offer or fulfill

provenance.method: irreversible-step policy

nodes.evaluation: Every publish-offer and fulfill step has a timestamped Frank approval before execution.

nodes.label: Frank release before Pack publish-pack or deliver-pack

provenance.method: irreversible-step policy for adjacent pack SKU

nodes.evaluation: Every publish-pack and deliver-pack step has a timestamped Frank approval before execution.

nodes.label: Starter Kit payload (primitives, prompts, inspectable architecture)

provenance.method: public starter-kit surface; payload still founder-gated

nodes.evaluation: A stranger can open the delivered files and run the first recipe without a DM to Frank.

nodes.label: Hosting, Whop/store fees, and agent draft time (unmetered estimate pending invoices)

provenance.method: honest gap — no invoice attached in this graph

nodes.evaluation: Time the next ten human-review + publish-offer gates. If median founder minutes exceed the monthly budget, lower automation thresholds or raise the kill date. Replace any future EUR amount with provider invoices only.
nodes.notes: founderMinutesPerMonth=480 is an estimate for gate review/release (not measured invoice). No EUR amount invented; E02 money-cost warning may remain until invoices exist.

nodes.label: First ten Starter Kit purchase attempts

provenance.method: planned market test for founder-zero

nodes.evaluation: Complete when ten strangers reach a buy/no-buy decision, not when ten ads are sent.

data.hypothesis: At least one of ten completed purchase attempts converts at the intended Starter Kit price without custom fulfillment.
data.decisionRule: Zero paid kits after ten completed attempts sends the thesis back to problem-tool-sprawl.

nodes.label: Stated €97/€7 prices are not yet attested as live checkout

provenance.method: live fetch vs interview memory mismatch risk

nodes.evaluation: Risk closes when a listing Evidence node shows the live price equal to the Offer, or Offers are updated to match live.

nodes.label: Monthly honesty pass on kit claims and prices

provenance.method: operating cadence

nodes.evaluation: Cadence met or Offer visibility drops to private until fixed.

nodes.label: No paid Starter Kit after first ten completed purchase attempts

provenance.method: pre-committed exit

nodes.evaluation: Checked on reviewBy against paid invoices only. Interest and replies do not count.

data.threshold: Zero paid Starter Kits after ten completed purchase attempts
